items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: I know when my daughter, Ione was 13, I gave a big party on Broad Street for her.

ctx.x: Have you noticed now how they're trying to jazz up everything? But why can't they jazz at all? Why did I have to get up? I'm going to the park Sunday again, and I'm going to ask the band leader. And then if you don't do what I ask them, I'll say, you ain't doing that. And Rudy Vallée was on in them days. But he didn't play jazz. He played the sweetest music this side of heaven, soft music. And he's still in existence. He the one people to know how old he is, but Rudy Vallée must be kind of old. I believe in 1934…
Did they play music at Wake's drum?
